_doc: Hand-fixed lines that take precedence over the translation batches. Password puzzles: the event script compares the player's input with fixed kana stored in script_NNN.bin, so the clue must show those exact characters. They are not stored here: {script:NNN:i} is replaced at build time with the i-th kana string found in script_NNN.bin of your own ROM.
